watches.name: Captain Stainless Steel Bracelet
watches.description: Elevate your Captain watch with a bracelet made for comfort, durability, and everyday versatility. 316L Stainless Steel Construction Crafted from high-grade 316L stainless steel , this bracelet is built to withstand daily wear while maintaining its refined finish. 316L steel is known for its corrosion resistance and long-term durability and ensures your bracelet keeps its luster whether you’re in the office, outdoors, or on the move. Quick-Release End Lugs Switching straps has never been easier. The integrated quick-release end lugs allow you to attach or remove the bracelet in seconds, no tools required. Seamlessly move between leather or steel depending on your preference. Quick-Release Clasp The bracelet features a secure, smooth-operating quick-release clasp designed for effortless fastening. It locks firmly in place to keep the Captain anchored to your wrist, yet releases cleanly with a squeeze when you’re ready to change straps. On-the-Fly Micro-Adjust Perfect fit, anytime. The on-the-fly micro-adjust mechanism lets you expand or contract the bracelet without tools needed. Whether your wrist changes throughout the day, you’re traveling, or you just need a little extra room, the adjustment system ensures all-day comfort with precision sizing. Bring out the full character of the Captain with a bracelet built to match its engineering and elegance. The Captain Watch is not included in this listing, and should be added separately for purchase.

watches.name: The Raja
watches.description: The Raja, inspired by a historic Marcks & Co. pocket watch once crafted for the Maharaja of Patiala, features a regal blue sun brushed dial with gold hands and a bi-color case. A symbol of timeless elegance. Case Execution: The case is made from 316L grade stainless steel with various finishings, and a gold plated bezel. The case back is a screw down exhibition back revealing the Sellita SW260-1, adorned to the highest decoration with perlage and blued screws. Crowned by our custom gold plated rotor engraved with Indian mandala patterns. The case is 40mm in diameter, with a 20mm lug width. The lug-to-lug is 47mm and the case thickness is 10.4mm. Movement: Swiss-Made Sellita SW260-1 Movement, with small seconds at the 6:00 position and a power reserve of 38 hours. 31 jewels and 28,800 beats per hour. This watch movement is an automatic movement with a self winding mechanism. Dial Execution: The dial is a regal blue tone, sunray brushed with an azurage finish along the railway and the small seconds subdial. The numerals are double printed with silver powder for excellent legibility and depth. Additional Specs: 40mm case diameter 20mm lug width Sapphire crystal 50M / 5ATM water resistance
